gate_policy: Original abs(D-A)<=0.005 PPL unchanged and RED. Name cause before proposing model-specific reference/tolerance. If storage cause confirmed, conditional AP uses same exact K/V at APA entry and abs(D-AP)<=0.005; AP-A separately reported. No gate widening.
replay_policy: Keep bitwise; first restore exact original call context. Require same native selection as the measured PPL call, preserve masks with call metadata. Tolerance only by separate evidence-backed registration.
